source_name: OpenStreetMap community food/cafe POIs via Overpass
notes: A community map snapshot; not an official food permit registry and not a complete list of Jeju businesses.
Current operation, menus, opening hours, business identity and mapped entrance are not verified.
Cuisine tags are community reference labels; no popularity, rating, visits or taste claims.
OSM dataset remains separate from Hub 780 permit records; no forced name/address identity matching.
Ways/relations use element bounding-box center, not an entrance or guaranteed interior point.
One fixed Jeju bounding-box query, no user GPS or personal preferences sent.
This derivative dataset retains ODbL attribution and share-alike terms.
